_note: NIST SP 800-218 (Secure Software Development Framework). Top-level practice groups plus individual practice IDs added as sub-skills need to cite them — PS.2/PS.2.1/PS.3.2 added at plan 014's implementation (2026-07-22), fetched directly from NIST SSDF sources, not guessed, since no CWE cleanly covers 'missing signing'/'missing SBOM' as a weakness pattern.

PS.2.title: Provide a Mechanism for Verifying Software Release Integrity

PS.2.1.title: Make integrity verification information available to software purchasers and consumers

PS.3.2.title: Collect, maintain, and share provenance data for all components and other dependencies of each software release (e.g., in a software bill of materials [SBOM])

PW.7.title: Review and/or Analyze Human-Readable Code to Identify Vulnerabilities and Verify Compliance with Security Requirements
